title: Compare methods across analysis scales
text: vignette compares two measurement methods three transformations: identity: absolute differences original scale log: ratio-focused agreement logit: agreement proportion-scale measurements
code: library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: 'dplyr' #> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union library(knitr) library(tidyr) library(ggBA)

title: Compare methods across analysis scales
text: temperature dataset stored long format (method + temperature values). pairwise comparisons, first create one column per method (infrared, rectal).
code: tbl <- temperature |>   pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = temperature)

title: Compare methods across analysis scales
text: Use absolute differences directly interpretable.
code: ba_stat(data = tbl, var1 = infrared, var2 = rectal) |>   pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = value) |>   kable(digits = 3) ba_plot(data = tbl, var1 = infrared, var2 = rectal) #> Warning: Using `by = character()` to perform a cross join was deprecated in dplyr 1.1.0. #> ℹ Please use `cross_join()` instead. #> ℹ The deprecated feature was likely used in the ggBA package. #>   Please report the issue to the authors. #> This warning is displayed once per session. #> Call `lifecycle::last_lifecycle_warnings()` to see where this warning was #> generated.

title: Compare methods across analysis scales
text: Use log transform proportional differences meaningful absolute ones. scale: log(var1) - log(var2) = log(var1 / var2) bias can back-transformed ratio: exp(bias) gives geometric mean ratio (infrared / rectal).
code: log_stats <- ba_stat(data = tbl, var1 = infrared, var2 = rectal, transform = "log")  log_stats |>   pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = value) |>   kable(digits = 4) log_bias <- log_stats |>   filter(parameter == "bias") |>   pull(value) cat("Geometric mean ratio (infrared / rectal):", round(exp(log_bias), 4), "\n") #> Geometric mean ratio (infrared / rectal): 1.0064 ba_plot(   data      = tbl,   var1      = infrared,   var2      = rectal,   transform = "log",   xlab      = "Mean of log(temperature)",   ylab      = "log(infrared / rectal)" )

title: Compare methods across analysis scales
text: values restricted (0, 1), logit transform often gives better variance behavior approximately Normal difference scale.
code: set.seed(42) prop_tbl <- data.frame(   p1 = runif(60, 0.05, 0.95),   p2 = runif(60, 0.05, 0.95) )  logit_stats <- ba_stat(data = prop_tbl, var1 = p1, var2 = p2, transform = "logit")  logit_stats |>   pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = value) |>   kable(digits = 3) ba_plot(   data      = prop_tbl,   var1      = p1,   var2      = p2,   transform = "logit",   xlab      = "Mean of logit(proportion)",   ylab      = "Difference on logit scale" )

title: Getting started with ggBA
text: short guide walks complete Bland-Altman workflow: reshape long-format data paired columns compute agreement statistics visualize agreement one line plotting code
code: library(knitr) library(tidyr) library(ggBA)

title: Getting started with ggBA
text: temperature contains one row per animal, visit, measurement method. compare two methods directly, pivot wide format.
code: tbl <- temperature |>   pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = temperature)  head(tbl, 6) |>   kable(digits = 2)

title: Getting started with ggBA
text: commonly interpreted quantities : bias: average difference methods lloa uloa: lower upper limits agreement
code: stats_tbl <- ba_stat(tbl, infrared, rectal) stats_tbl |>   tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = value) |>   kable(digits = 3)

title: Getting started with ggBA
code: ba_plot(   data = tbl,   var1 = infrared,   var2 = rectal,   title = "Infrared vs rectal temperature",   caption = "Lines show bias and limits of agreement with confidence bounds." ) #> Warning: Using `by = character()` to perform a cross join was deprecated in dplyr 1.1.0. #> ℹ Please use `cross_join()` instead. #> ℹ The deprecated feature was likely used in the ggBA package. #>   Please report the issue to the authors. #> This warning is displayed once per session. #> Call `lifecycle::last_lifecycle_warnings()` to see where this warning was #> generated.

title: Getting started with ggBA
text: baseline workflow, explore: transformed analyses (transform = "log" "logit") grouped analyses via group = ba_stat() ba_plot()

title: Grouped and stratified Bland-Altman analysis
text: Agreement can differ across biological operational subgroups.ggBA supports grouped summaries faceted plots inspect patterns.
code: library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: 'dplyr' #> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union library(knitr) library(tidyr) library(ggBA)

title: Grouped and stratified Bland-Altman analysis
code: tbl <- temperature |>   pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = temperature)

title: Grouped and stratified Bland-Altman analysis
text: table highlights subgroup-level shifts bias spread.
code: treatment_stats <- ba_stat(   data = tbl,   var1 = infrared,   var2 = rectal,   group = treatment )  treatment_stats |>   filter(parameter %in% c("bias", "lloa", "uloa")) |>   tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = parameter, values_from = value) |>   arrange(treatment) |>   kable(digits = 3)

title: Grouped and stratified Bland-Altman analysis
code: ba_plot(   data = tbl,   var1 = infrared,   var2 = rectal,   group = treatment,   colour = visit,   title = "Agreement by treatment group",   caption = "Each panel has treatment-specific Bland-Altman summary lines." )

title: Grouped and stratified Bland-Altman analysis
text: multiplicative differences relevant, add transform = "log":
code: ba_stat(   data = tbl,   var1 = infrared,   var2 = rectal,   group = treatment,   transform = "log" ) |>   filter(parameter == "bias") |>   mutate(geom_ratio = exp(value)) |>   select(treatment, geom_ratio) |>   arrange(treatment) |>   kable(digits = 3)

title: Derive mean and difference for Bland-Altman analysis — ba_mean_diff
text: helper function computes mean difference (ratio) two variables applying transformation.  Supported transformations "identity" (transformation), "log" (natural logarithm, ratio back original scale), "logit" (logit transformation).

title: Derive mean and difference for Bland-Altman analysis — ba_mean_diff
code: ba_mean_diff(   data = stop("data must be specified"),   var1 = stop("variable must be specified"),   var2 = stop("variable must be specified"),   transform = c("identity", "log", "logit") )

title: Derive mean and difference for Bland-Altman analysis — ba_mean_diff
text: data data frame. var1 1st variable compare (unquoted). var2 2nd variable compare (unquoted). transform Transformation apply computing mean difference.  One "identity" (default), "log", "logit".

title: Derive mean and difference for Bland-Altman analysis — ba_mean_diff
